gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/packages/cli/src/program.ts)

Read this repository, propose a policy, and write it after a yes.

```text
gspot init [options]
```

## Options

| Flag                        | Meaning                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version`                 | Print the version and nothing else                                           |
| `--json`                    | Print the documented JSON object instead of text                             |
| `--quiet`                   | Print failures only                                                          |
| `--verbose`                 | Print every command with its arguments and every ignore with its reason      |
| `--no-color`                | No color in the output                                                       |
| `-C <dir>`                  | Run as if started in that directory                                          |
| `--yes`                     | Take every proposal without asking                                           |
| `--from <profile>`          | Install from a profile: a path, an https URL or github:owner/repo            |
| `--presets <presets...>`    | The root presets instead of the detected ones                                |
| `--without <presets...>`    | Presets to leave out of the proposal                                         |
| `--scope <path=presets...>` | Scopes and their comma-separated presets                                     |
| `--no-install`              | Skip the install step and print the command instead                          |
| `--allow-dirty`             | Run although the working tree has uncommitted changes                        |
| `--hooks <tool>`            | Where hooks go (choices: "gspot", "lefthook", "husky")                       |
| `--ci <provider>`           | Write a CI workflow (choices: "github", "gitlab")                            |
| `--no-hooks`                | Do not install hooks                                                         |
| `--no-ci`                   | Write no CI workflow                                                         |
| `--no-rules`                | Leave the agent rule files out                                               |
| `--format <choice>`         | Keep existing or use shipped formatter settings (choices: "keep", "shipped") |
| `--runner <tool>`           | The task runner (choices: "mise", "npm", "bun", "pnpm", "uv")                |
| `--no-runner`               | Write no task-runner configuration                                           |
| `--dry-run`                 | Print the plan and write nothing                                             |
| `-h, --help`                | display help for command                                                     |
